shots.visual: A heavy iron shield is shattered by a glowing bolt, sparks flying everywhere.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這弩箭...竟然射穿了玄鐵盾？

shots.visual: Standing calmly behind a table with blueprints, arms crossed.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這叫改良型連弩，威力加倍。

shots.visual: Examining a smaller, more compact crossbow with wide eyes.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 弩身縮小一半，射程卻更遠？

shots.visual: Pointing at the internal mechanical structure of the weapon.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 因為我改了內部的齒輪構造。

shots.visual: Staring at his lord with a mix of awe and confusion.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公何時精通此等機巧之術？

shots.visual: Pouring tea calmly, the steam rising in front of his face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 夢中偶得，不足掛齒。

shots.visual: Walking towards a massive iron-clad battering ram with spikes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 蜀軍營地，神兵列陣。

shots.visual: Touching the cold steel of the giant engine, trembling slightly.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這攻城槌，竟帶有連環機括？

shots.visual: Standing in front of the engine, looking like a conqueror.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 一次撞擊，抵得過百人衝鋒。

shots.visual: Looking at the blueprint again, realizing the tactical shift.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 以此攻打東吳，如熱刀切黃油。

shots.visual: The wind blows his cape as he looks toward the horizon.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權的船隊，在它面前就是木板。

shots.visual: Kneeling down on one knee, showing absolute submission.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 亮，心悅誠服，主公真神人也。

shots.visual: Looking down at his strategist, hand on his sword hilt.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 亮，眼光要放長遠一點。

shots.visual: Walking to the war map, slamming a black pawn onto the capital.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 我要的，是整個天下。

shots.visual: Gulping, feeling the immense pressure from the lord.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 臣，必鞠躬盡瘁，輔佐主公。

shots.visual: Rows of soldiers lifting the new crossbows simultaneously.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 蜀軍士氣，瞬時攀至巔峰。

shots.visual: A shadow passes over his eyes, revealing a cold ambition.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 東吳欠我的，該還了。

shots.visual: Looking at the destructive power of the tests in the distance.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這簡直是超越時代的力量。

shots.visual: Turning his head slightly, a sinister smirk on his lips.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這還只是開始。

shots.visual: The screen focuses on his burning, determined eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 後面還有更猛的。

shots.visual: The entire army cheers as a wall in the distance crumbles. Fade to black.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 神兵之威，即將席捲東吳。
